examples.description: Restore version 12 of one studio project

description: Bring back an earlier version of a studio project: it saves that version as a new version; history is never rewritten, so the version it replaces stays listed and restoring that one undoes this. Returns {version, restored_from, previous_version}. A person editing the project in the browser is told at their next save that a newer version is on the server and reloads. Refuses: a project_id outside your scope (NOT_FOUND): studio_project_list lists your projects; pass one of their ids; a version the project no longer stores (SIMPLER_STUDIO_VERSION_NOT_STORED): call studio.list_versions and pick a listed one; a stored version that no longer passes the composition schema (SIMPLER_STUDIO_VERSION_UNREADABLE): restore a different version; another save landing at the same moment (SIMPLER_STUDIO_RESTORE_CONFLICT): call again. Free.
